## Core Projects

- **Twyned - Social Media App:** A full-featured social platform focusing on user engagement and content sharing.
- **Convo - Chat Application:** Real-time communication platform using Socket.io and MERN stack.
- **NEO Earth Tracker:** Interactive monitoring of near-Earth objects using NASA's official API.
- **MockingBird - Sarcasm Translator:** A witty AI application that converts regular text into sarcastic responses using LLMs.
